rationale: M60 LUA-06, authored from the principle that a relationship is a fact about the PROGRAM, not about the traversal. Both declaration orders appear in this file and BOTH must produce the edge, each at its own call's line. Before the fix the first produced an edge and the second produced nothing, with identical semantics — which is why one file carrying both is the whole test.

expectRelationships.comment: CALL BEFORE DECLARATION — the order that used to produce no edge at all
CALL AFTER DECLARATION — the order that used to work, kept as the control
